hook.name: SlipstreamAggregator
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that aggregates concentrated liquidity from Slipstream-style CL pools (tickSpacing-keyed factory lookup). On each swap, it routes execution to the corresponding external Slipstream pool and settles the resulting token deltas back to the v4 PoolManager via beforeSwap delta, with an optional protocol fee applied.
